D.en: Having succeeded in multiple investigations, Espimon has become highly mobilized so that it can obtain more accurate information. It can now navigate over long distances, fly, and dive, and its field of activity extends to the depths of the "Net Ocean" and altitudes of up to 20,000m, making it possible for it to investigate hidden Digimon. Its "Divanish" optical camouflage has also been updated. It masks the sounds it makes along with its appearance, and is capable of infiltrating or causing a disturbance without being noticed, even when maneuvering at high speeds. Thanks to the VR Goggles on its brow, the target's movements after a few seconds are predictively displayed, allowing it to act with precision.    Its Special Moves include "Stamper Missile", in which it fires missiles from its two rear launchers, "Breast Cannon", in which it shoots the vulcan cannons on its breast, and "Doronger", in which it spreads a smokescreen from both its hands to hide its allies; it has prepared techniques suited for reconnaissance-in-force. Also, it is rumored to be used by the Crack Team for intelligence operations in various locations.
ne: with a Vaccine or Free Attribute Adult Digimon from the Vital Bracelet Digital Monster
with a Data Attribute Adult Digimon from the Vital Bracelet Digital Monster

D.en: A form of Huanglongmon that went berserk after being imbued with malice energy. Having lost its goodness and light, it became a being inclined towards evil and darkness alone, and rampages to bring the world to ruin. According to records, the Four Holy Beasts joined forces and succeeded in subduing the rampant Huanglongmon.    Its Special Moves are causing everything in the Digital World to be swallowed up by nothing but darkness, devoid of any light (Mukyoku), and generating a tornado with black flames on the scale of a natural disaster (Kaimeisō).

A giant Aquatic Digimon whose whole body is covered in scales boasting a hardness rivaling that of Chrome Digizoid. It has a gentle personality, prefers clear water, and protects the areas around lakes from environmental pollution. When feeding, it will jump out of the lake, move as if it is swimming in the air, and swallow flying Digimon whole to satisfy its appetite. Also, because its large build makes it an easy target, it often blends in with flocks of Xiquemon to travel around. For that reason, whenever it moves, it will surround the flock with a large amount of bubbles to protect itself. Since the bubbles refract light, the entire flock, including Huankunmon itself, become transparent and cannot be seen from their surroundings.    Its Special Moves are enveloping the enemy in a bubble produced from its fin to restrict their movements (Korōhō), and spitting out countless sharp icicles from its mouth (Hyōran Kettotsu). In addition, it generates a whirlpool from out of nowhere, forming a pillar of water that slams into the enemy (Chōryū Senka).

A Principality-type Perfect Digimon of equal rank to Holy Angemon and Angewomon. It has a strong sense of concern for others, and is frequently seen interacting with various Digimon. Perhaps it is because of this personality that its fighting style specializes in defense, and since it also excels in ingenuity, it acts as both an adviser and commander in its assigned unit. It usually appears on the battlefield to protect its Luxmon and Angemon subordinates, while issuing direct commands to support them in battle.    It seldom goes on a direct offensive itself, and often employs Gargomon and Manticoremon as familiars, summoning them from a maelstrom of flames using the two "Holy Chains" wrapped around its arms.    Its Special Moves are summoning several familiars and unleashing them all at once (Saint Legion), and amplifying the flames contained within its sacred staff, the "Holy Rod", to incinerate the enemy (Heaven's Flame). In addition, its support move "Brave Aura" envelops its allies in the flames emitted from the Holy Rod, protecting them from enemy attacks.

A Digimon that is thought to have appeared the moment the ancient Digital World was destroyed. It is said that it sacrificed its own life to summon a Digitama from the sorrow of the Digimon that disappeared one after another as a result of the destruction. However, there are no records of whether this act had been accomplished or not. Although the existence of Ultimates known as the legendary Ten Warriors has been documented during the era of the ancient Digital World, it is presumed that Big Ukkomon also possessed an amount of data equivalent to an Ultimate, but it has not been possible to verify this.    Its Special Move is swinging its countless, supermassive tentacles, crushing and gouging targets over a vast range (Violent Punisher).

A Lesser Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft fur. It takes interest in everything it sees, and has a habit of sniffing them out. Although it is an active Digimon, it immediately tumbles over when running due to its short legs. It is unable to ascend or descend places with a difference in elevation greater than the length of its legs, so when it comes to areas that frequently differ in elevation, it moves around while rolling. If someone hostile approaches it, it will intimidate them with a spark-filled bark called "Puppy Spark".

D-Brigade had perfected an Ultimate Digimon as their weapon of last resort in the past, but this individual caused a fiasco when it broke out after running wild. After reflecting upon their failure to produce the strongest and most unique Digimon to represent their organization, they evolved and developed a Digimon as a command aircraft for managing troops efficiently—Brigadramon. It circles above the mission area, searching for and destroying threats on the ground or at low altitudes. Once a major threat has been eliminated, Cargodramon carrying squadrons will land, deploying Commandramon, Hi-Commandramon, and Tankdramon on the ground. Brigadramon circles the skies until the mission is complete, continuously giving commands to the deployed troops and performing reconnaissance. Its Special Moves are strafing with high-explosive projectiles shot at a speed of 4,800 rounds per second using the huge Gatling cannon on its right arm (Genocide Rain), and organic missiles housed within the claws on its left hand (Exa Destroyer). For a time, D-Brigade had lost their reputation due to the fiasco, but after the deployment of Brigadramon, their operational success rate has improved, and their troop loss rate has dropped significantly, so they are starting to regain their former reputation. There are also reports that three Brigadramon are currently in commission, and that number is expected to further increase in the future.

A Digimon in charge of troop transport for the mechanized "D-Brigade". It is said to have evolved by taking in tiltrotor aircraft design data from the Real World obtained via hacking. It has excellent maneuverability that allows it to hover and fly at high-speed by adjusting the angle of the propellers on both of its wings. Cargodramon's fuselage has a cargo hold, and on normal missions, it often houses a squadron of five Commandramon and one Hi-Commandramon. Also, when the cargo hold is empty, it can carry a single Tankdramon by suspending wires under its fuselage. Its Special Move is attacking with the Gatling gun on the front of its fuselage (Suppression Strike). It is used for ground suppression when deploying troops. If a close combat situation arises due to unforeseen circumstances, it will hack the opponent to pieces with its "Slaughter Blade", in which it slashes them with the propellers on both of its wings. This technique may damage the propellers, so it is only allowed to be used in emergencies.

Cthyllamon inhabits the depths of the Net Ocean, and is known by the alias "Phantom of the Ocean" due to the fact that only the skull pattern on its chest can be seen floating eerily in the dark sea. Instead of actively fighting on its own, it employs aquatic Digimon that are a lower Level than itself by brainwashing them, and has a crafty and cunning disposition. Because of its appearance, and since it is rarely ever seen, it shares many similarities with Marin Angemon, but the relationship between them remains unknown.    Its Special Move "Ocean Hell", in which it steals the opponent's fighting spirit with an aura of endless terror akin to the darkness at the depths of the sea, sometimes reduces Digimon that suffer this technique to being Cthyllamon's puppets. Its "Buccal Rush", in which it opens its mouth wide and attacks with its three long, flexible tongues in a whip-like manner, and its "Aqua Grinder", where it generates an intense whirlpool that bores into the opponent's body like a drill, possess destructive power that is unimaginable from its tiny physique.
pe: with any Virus Perfect Digimon from the Digimon Pendulum COLOR

with any Virus Perfect Digimon from the Digimon Pendulum COLOR
with or without any Virus Perfect Digimon from the Digimon Pendulum COLOR

D.en: A Mutation Digimon with a grotesque appearance whose whole body is covered in leather. Since it doesn't speak nor try to express anything with its body, it usually just stands on the spot in an eerie silence. Generally speaking, it has no interest in self-expression, and is an evil Digimon that specializes only in robbing others of life.    It slips into crowds of Digimon from out of nowhere and sends out a signal that stimulates their combat instinct akin to telepathy, causing the Digimon to fight each other, bringing about chaos.    Its Special Moves are blowing the enemy away with a shock wave generated by swinging its long tail (Kyōsenkai), and knocking down enemies bound with its extensible arms from the sky (Jurenshōkoku). In addition, in its "Konton Akūkyo", in which it opens the zippers on its body to pull the opponent in, not even Dijiangmon itself knows where they will disappear to once they have been swallowed.

Fenriloogamon is an imaginary Digimon born from the "Daydream of a Digicore". It is a form that had even the Digicore's own creativity miraculously released through the Interface on its brow, and evolved. Possibly because it naturally possessed the data of the warg from real-world mythology within its Digicore, the form created by its Digicore is an "Ultimate Demon Beast", clad in silver armor and wielding an inexhaustible supply of magical power. The magical blue flames that envelop its whole body are kept under control at its own volition, and despite having an extremely high burning temperature, they normally flicker silently and beautifully. Its Special Moves are causing the blue flames that cover its body to explosively combust in an instant while howling, incinerating its surroundings (Ragnarök Howling), and tearing the opponent to pieces with laser-like magical flames that spurt from its limbs (Jötunheimr Gale). In addition, it can also summon a duplicate of itself made of magical flames called "Hróðvitnir", and since the duplicate uses the same techniques as Fenriloogamon, those who face it will struggle considerably.

The ornament around Fenriloogamon's neck, known as "Gleipnir", is inscribed with ancient magic, and it is said that when Fenriloogamon's Digicore is filled with strong "emotions", that magic is invoked, and is capable of materializing those "emotions". Fenriloogamon: Takemikazuchi is a form achieved by causing Kazuchimon to undergo a miraculous evolution using the effects of this magic. Its Special Move is "Shūkyoku Senjin Takemikazuchi", a deadly slash attack that it unleashes, harboring the power of lightning and magical flames within the "Takemikazuchi" greatsword held in its mouth. Also, the Takemikazuchi greatsword can be split into two, and are occasionally wielded from both ends of Gleipnir, which has transformed into a thick rope. Fenriloogamon: Takemikazuchi is able to freely manipulate Gleipnir at its own volition, and the technique it unleashes with these two swords is called "Zetsugoku Butō Takemikazuchi".

A Slime Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft fur. Although it is a Digimon brimming with curiosity that loves to move around, it spends most of its time sleeping due to it tiring easily. When danger draws near, it will emit a high-pitched, threatening cry called "Puppy Noise".

A Demon Beast Digimon that is, because of the outdated Interface on its brow, presumed to be an experimental "Prototype Digimon" from before Digimon were discovered. It is said that the data of the warg from real-world mythology is embedded within the deepest parts of its Digicore, and it exhibits behavior so violent that you would not expect it from a Child. At first glance, it looks like a cute puppy, but if one approaches it carelessly, they will be on the receiving end of a fierce counterattack. It has a trait of recognizing those who can control it as its master, and despite being difficult to tame, it can become a reliable companion if one is able to build a trustful relationship with it. Its Special Moves are shooting flames imbued with magical power from its mouth (Howling Fire), and biting with its sharp fangs as it spins (Spiral Bite).

A Demon Beast Digimon that generates an enormous amount of magical power within its body. The amount of magical power it generates is extraordinary, so it constantly releases it from its mouth in the form of flames. These flames have enough burning and spreading power to incinerate its surroundings just by roaring. Since the flames are rooted in magic, they burn for quite a long time, and those who are attacked will suffer more damage than expected. Because it has an outdated Interface on its brow, it is presumed to be an evolution of a "Prototype Digimon". Its Special Moves are amassing flames and firing them from its mouth as a beam (Howling Burner), and enveloping its whole body in magical flames and performing a ramming attack (Flame Blow).
ne: with any Data Adult or any Virus Adult Digimon from the Digimon Pendulum COLOR
with any Vaccine Adult Digimon from the Digimon Pendulum COLOR

D.en: An Angel Digimon with a small, child-like body that belongs to the lowest rank among angels. It is often teased by Impmon and Pico Devimon, possibly because of its pure, innocent nature which makes it incapable of seeing through lies. It does not possess much power due to it being a Child, but once in battle, it is able to demonstrate its true strength in fighting against superior opponents by working together with other Luxmon.    Its Special Move is a fist technique where it imitates Angemon, whom it aspires to be, to the best of its ability (Pico Knuckle). Its "Cloud Barrier", in which it deploys a circular shield of light around it, increases its defensive power manyfold when deployed by several Luxmon at the same time.

A Digimon that succeeded in controlling the sinister magic data of the mythical warg, which slept within the deepest parts of its Digicore. Program code written in a special language lines the inside of the armor that covers its whole body, suppressing its enormous amount of magical power, which is transformed into raging magical flames, as if it were sealed magic. Soloogarmon is able to freely manipulate the magical flames by modifying the program code, and these manipulated flames can be utilized for all kinds of actions, such as attacking, moving, and posture control. It can produce a focused, ultra-high-temperature magical flame called "Prominence Laser" from the index and middle fingers of both its hands, and despite being a flame, it can shoot through distant enemies as if it were a laser beam. Its Special Move is making the magical flame of the "Vánagandr", the mace in its right hand, burn at its highest temperature, forming a blade and slashing with it (Eruption Howling). It is said that when the ultra-high-temperature flame blade chafes against the air, it makes a sound like the howling of a wolf. In addition, it also uses "Sköll Rage", an attack where it uses the thrust of the magical flames spurting from both its shoulders to move at high speed, and then hurl the Vánagandr at the opponent.
ne: with any Vaccine Perfect Digimon from the Digimon Pendulum COLOR
with any Data Perfect or any Virus Perfect Digimon from the Digimon Pendulum COLOR

D.en: A God Man Digimon born from the data of a certain warrior from Chinese legend. It is a hero who despises deceiving others, and uses its sword to resolve actions that deviate from the path of righteousness. It frequently imposes its own sense of justice onto others, and since it does not even make the effort to explain itself again, it often fights alone.    It has abandoned dialogue with anyone else and remains extremely taciturn, possibly because it believes that one's own thoughts are enough as long as they make sense to oneself. When forced into a conservation with someone, Takutoumon's white mouse-shaped, karakuri pet "Paishū" will speak on its behalf. As such, whenever Takutoumon speaks itself, it is limited to when it has something particularly important to say.    Also, its treasure tool "Bǎo Tǎ", which contains data from Shakamon, is housed within the gauntlet on its left palm, and since it can use this to seal away the opponent's fighting spirit, Takutoumon forces the Digimon that oppose it to become more docile.Its Special Moves are unleashing a blade of light from its swung treasure sword (Tenseizan), and projecting an enlarged Bǎo Tǎ above the opponent's head and dropping it on them, crushing them (Tettensaisai).

A Mineral Digimon that can be said to be the avatar of nature, ruling over rain and thunder. It has the ability to bless dry land with rain, and inflict divine punishment upon those who destroy nature with lightning to purify them. It is usually cheerful and calm, but occasionally displays ferocity to the point of being brutal. Its dual nature, akin to embodying nature itself, awes the Digimon that inhabit the land.    While it has a cute, child-like appearance, it has extremely high specs even in battle, and its body, which is made of ore data, boasts high hardness, and it attacks by freely manipulating the grass and vines that grow all over its body.    Its Special Moves are summoning rain and thunder through a peculiar dance, and transforming them into blades to slash the enemy (Netotiliztli), and combining the energies of rain and thunder together and firing it as a massive beam (Nahui Quiahuitl).
pe: with El Doradimon or Saber Leomon
with El Doradimon or Metal Etemon
with Saber Leomon or Metal Etemon

D.en: A Bird Dragon Digimon that flies about freely through the skies over vast forests. The horns on its head are soft, and serve more as sensory organs than they do for offense. It can acutely perceive changes in climate by reading the wind striking against its horns.    It has a strong interest in other species, and often flies through the sky alongside them in attempt to make contact; this includes Child Digimon such as Piyomon and Falcomon, and occasionally larger Adult and Perfect Digimon. Also, it has the ability to instantly regrow its feathers to heal its wounds when injured.    Its Special Moves are a slash attack where it flaps its arm-wings to send out a blade of wind (Wind Slicer), and piercing the enemy with the talons on its feet while flying (Rumble Claw).
ne: with or without certain Digimon from the Digimon Card Game

D.en: An Ultimate Digimon enshrined in the aerial city of "Larc", which floats above the vast "Net Ocean", shrouded by enormous clouds. Quantumon extracts huge amounts of data from the Net Ocean using the expansion devices installed on Larc, and runs millions upon trillions of simulations of the future. Together with its Digimon followers, Quantumon implements the best measures it has formulated against disasters that are predicted to occur in the Digital World.    Its Special Move is transforming space into a gate via quantum processing, and forcefully sending the enemy into another dimension (Unlimited Journey). This technique can also be used to forcibly evade other Digimon, or send them to another dimension for their own research and analysis. In addition, it can also manipulate the flow of time, causing quantum decay at specific coordinates with its "Hazy Time".

A Puppet Digimon that wears the leather of shoes and the skin of plush toys. If someone tries to touch it, it will jump quickly and immediately flee. Due to its timid nature, it can acutely sense vibrations in the floor or ground it is in contact with, and quickly detect the presence of invading enemies. The sole of its shoe has a very strong grip, allowing it to move smoothly over any rough road, and climb even vertical walls and pillars with ease as well. Since it prefers cleanliness, it dislikes walking in sandy areas or on muddy roads.    Sweet fruits are its favorite food, and when the sole of its shoe opens like jaws, it heartily bites into and eats fruits along with their tough skins.    Its Special Moves are a two-step attack where it jumps high while detaching the sole of its shoe from its main body (Wonder Stomp), and stitching the opponent up with a large amount of sewing needles it spits out of its mouth, preventing them from moving (Petit Needle). These sewing needles, with the thread attached, are also used when traveling to distant locations.

A Digimon in a chaotic state, overflowing with an enormous amount of magical power, whose form was released through the Interface on its brow by the sinister magic data of the mythical warg, which slept within the deepest parts of its Digicore. That enormous amount of magical power is transformed into magical flames, which keep spewing forth endlessly. The ultra-high-temperature magical flames have consumed even Helloogarmon itself, so nearly its entire body has been replaced by those flames. It has also lost its sense of self, and its sole governing principle is to incinerate everything around it. Its Special Moves are firing a blast of flames that spread from its mouth (Howling Burst), and tearing the enemy to pieces with its claws enveloped in ultra-high-temperature magical flames (Inferno Claw). The attack in which it unleashes "Inferno Claw" with both hands, and crushes the opponent between its hands while tearing them apart is called "Hati Embrace".

A heavy infantry Digimon from the mechanized "D-Brigade". It is said that many of those that are not chosen in "Selection-D", a special selection test that screens through 100 Commandramon, evolve into Hi-Commandramon. Its main role is to act as a "shield", and defend assault troops of Commandramon with its enormous build and protective shield. The surface of its skin has been modified with a special texture similar to Commandramon's, and has the function of displaying its surrounding colors in real-time. Its Special Moves are firing from its multi-grenade launcher (DCD Grenade), and performing a ramming attack with its protective shield (Destroy Charge). "DCD Grenade" is equipped with a special warhead, which can instantly switch between high-explosive projectiles, smoke bullets, and sonic bullets.

An Ultimate Digimon born from the data of the fairy tale "Cinderella". Despite its appearance, it inhabits volcanic regions. It is based at "Cinderella Castle", which is made of volcanic ash, and lives quietly so as to not attract the attention of others. However, when other Digimon visit the castle, it holds fighting tournaments called "Balls", and spends all of its time battling in search of its Prince—the Digimon that can defeat it.    The large number of familiars that accompany Cendrillmon are always wandering around vast areas, searching for candidates that could be its Prince, and distribute glass slippers in areas where strong Digimon that could win Cendrillmon's favor may live, and go around directly handing out glass slippers to the powerful. The glass slippers are troublesome items in that they forcibly transport those who possess them to Cinderella Castle, if they have a certain level of strength.    Its Special Moves are skewering the opponent with its glass slippers, which also serve as weapons due to their high hardness (Marriage Strike), and placing its familiars on pumpkin carriage-shaped bombs and having them perform a self-sacrificing attack (Noble Familiarts). In addition, it can also transform a large glass clock into a gigantic launcher, and uses its "Prism Date Break", in which it fires an extremely powerful laser beam from the large clock it holds, to eradicate the candidates for Prince in its surroundings.

A Perfect Digimon whose body is composed of data from ornamental dolls and fairy tales. It has taken on a humanoid form, but since its body is similar to a doll, its joints bend in the wrong direction, so it surprises those who see it. It carries a large amount of "Mini Monzaemon Gummies" in its basket, and eats them whenever it has free time, even when it isn't hungry.    While it has a calm demeanor, it actually prefers hunting and has quite a belligerent personality. When it comes to hunting, it takes out various weapons from the basket it carries around, and hunts its targets using all kinds of attack methods. Its targets are primarily Wolf-species Digimon, and in particular, if it finds a Fangmon, who possesses Big Bad Wolf data, it will focus on Fangmon to the exclusion of all else, and chase it down until the hunt is complete. Its hobby is using the data from the wolves it has hunted to make new shoes.    Its Special Moves are throwing a Molotov cocktail that utilizes cider (Apple For You), slashing at the enemy with its handheld knife and the ones stocked on both its feet as if dancing wildly (Crimson Ripper), and firing a magnificent, ceaseless volley from the Gatling gun that pops out of its basket (Mercy Basket).

A God Man Digimon born from the data of a certain warrior from Chinese legend. It acts in accordance with its conviction to rid all Digimon of their wicked hearts, and others refer to it as an upright Digimon due to the way it is honest.    A master that wields the Sān Jiān Liǎng Rèn Dāo as freely as its own limbs, it is also accompanied by its sentient treasure tool "Kōtenken", which resembles the head of a giant dog, and cherishes it as its companion, appearing anywhere in an instant regardless of the situation when summoned, and excelling in surprise attacks. In addition, Erlangmon also has a transformation ability that is said to allow it to change into any Digimon. However, while it is capable of perfectly imitating their appearance, it cannot copy their abilities, so this transformation ability is often used for distractions or espionage.    Also, the third eye on its forehead has the power to see through the opponent's weak spots and wicked hearts, and together with its ever-changing tactics, it is extremely difficult for those opposing it, or those hiding wicked hearts to escape from its grasp.    Its Special Moves are swinging the Sān Jiān Liǎng Rèn Dāo around itself in one sweep, and eliminating enemies in its surroundings with a circular slash (Yōsen Enbu), and summoning Kōtenken to crunch the enemy's Digicore (Shōrai: Kōtenken).

A Small Bird Digimon that operates while hiding within the luscious leaves of the forest trees. Although it is still unable to fly due to its wings being undeveloped, it is agile enough to dash up vertical tree trunks in one go. Its Special Move is a headbutt that capitalizes on its speed (Birdy Head). Once it sees that the invading enemy has been intimidated by this technique, it will flee as fast as it can.

A Bird Dragon Digimon characterized by its large wings and blade-like horns. Its hardened horns are even more developed than Pteromon's, allowing it to quickly perceive any abnormalities in its surroundings through the wind they detect, akin to a sixth sense. It is an intelligent species that strikes the first blow by predicting not only environmental changes, but also threats such as enemy invasions or attacks. It is also able to move around on four legs, and before battle, it can crouch down to mask its presence as it approaches the enemy.    Since it prefers fruits and nuts as its main food, it has a deep connection to Plant-species Digimon. It has a symbiotic relationship with Plant-species Digimon where they provide Galemon with food, and it protects their territory in return.    Its Special Moves are using its wings to unleash a large, sharp blade of wind (Hurricane Slicer), and generating a tornado from its mouth to blow the enemy away (Tornado Thrower).
ne: with or without certain Digimon from the Digimon Card Game

D.en: The form that Takutoumon boldly Mode Changes into when throwing itself into great battles. The Bǎo Tǎ has materialized into armor, its white mouse-shaped karakuri has transformed into a trident, and its appearance is a manifestation of the data of an "Eastern God" who is identified with a legendary warrior.    It amplifies its own power by releasing the vast amount of fighting spirit it had stolen and sealed within the Bǎo Tǎ all at once. However, it is an extremely aggressive and dangerous form that went into a state one can safely say is berserk as a result of gaining this immense power.    The Bǎo Tǎ, which is now its armor, not only protects its body, but can also be detached into smaller components and deployed as autonomous attack units for long-range shooting.    Its Special Move is a tricky slash attack where the detached Bǎo Tǎ disperse, and reflect the trajectory of the blade of light released from its trident (Ryūsen Rangeki). Its "Bishamon Hakkyoku Senjin" is both an offensive and defensive technique in which it uses all of the deployed Bǎo Tǎ units to form a defensive barrier while simultaneously firing a massive laser that can blast even mountains away.

A Slime Digimon that still wears the shell from its Digitama. It has a carefree personality and lives its life by slipping into the nests of other Digimon. Because its Digitama shell acts as camouflage, it evolves while hardly being spotted. If by any chance it gets discovered by invading enemies, it will intimidate other Digimon with bubbles produced from its body.

An Ultimate Digimon known as the God of Wind, it is an embodiment of the wind data that flows in the Digital World. It primarily operates in forest regions, and uses the wind to carry warm air, ripening the fruits of the trees, and protects not only Digimon but also the environment itself.     Zephagamon's Digicore, the source of its power, is situated beneath the wings on its chest, and is constantly protected by whirling winds. In addition, it is said that, in the event of an emergency, it prevents disasters by expelling energy directly from the atmosphere through its exposed Digicore.    The wind Zephagamon surrounds itself with and unleashes has magical properties, and it is considered one of the heroes of the Vortex Warriors.    Its Special Moves are transforming each of the swords in its hands into boomerangs, and unleashing a slashing attack enveloped in a tornado (Gale Braver), and transforming its wings into wind energy forms and bisecting the enemy as it passes by them (Anemoi Embrace). Finally, its "Divine Tempest", in which it expands the wings on its chest and releases the maximum amount of wind energy from its Digicore, sends enemies flying off into the distance, scraping the earth away.
ne: with or without certain Digimon from the Digimon Card Game

D.en: An agile Puppet Digimon that travels as if it is gliding through treetops on roller skates. It moves around restlessly, and dislikes staying still.    Its cheek pouches, where it usually keeps its food in, have a larger capacity than they look, and it can also place important items besides food in them to carry around. In addition, if they won't fit in its cheek pouches, it forces them between the gaps in its tail or inside the zipper on its abdomen. Because it has a habit of collecting things as well as stealing things, it will occasionally snatch food from other Digimon while passing by them.    Its Special Moves are "Rolling Stomper", in which it presses down on the rapidly-spinning tires of its roller skates, and its "Donguri Bomb", where it throws an acorn-shaped bomb taken out of the zipper on its abdomen, causes a large amount of acorns to fly off along with an explosion, dealing damage over a vast area.
ne: with or without certain Digimon from the Digimon Card Game

D.en: A large Perfect Digimon renowned as King of the Forest. The armor covering it up to its wings and beak is coated with magic. It skillfully blends into its surroundings by reflecting light in a special way, and despite having large wings, it is also able to muffle sounds by flapping them.    Its huge comb-like horn symbolizes it as king of the forest, and it is said that many Digimon inhabiting the forest will bow down just looking at it.    The wind generated by its gunbai "Stymphalides", which was made with wind magic, also has the role of conveying Grand Galemon's thoughts, and it ensures the safety of the forest by delivering instructions and warnings to groups of Galemon via this wind.    Also, since it uses magic, it is considered to be one of the Digimon belonging to the "Vortex Warriors", led by Medieval Dukemon.    Its Special Moves are using Stymphalides to unleash a wind that cuts down everything around it all at once (Dragonic Storm), and flying and charging the enemy while going into a tailspin, tearing through them with its metal wings (Wing Tornado).
ne: with or without certain Digimon from the Digimon Card Game

D.en: A Digimon with a beautiful appearance that resides in Ryūshōgu, an oceanic area in the eastern Digital World. It constantly emits a faint light from its translucent body, charming those who see it.    Not only does it have a beautiful appearance, but also extremely high combat ability. It is revered as the lord of Ryūshōgu as well as its guardian deity, and the peace in this area, which is also known as a paradise for water-dwelling Digimon, has been brought about thanks to Ryugumon.    It possesses both high intelligence and a calm disposition, and although it has a nature that despises conflict, it will wield its mysterious power to the fullest to counter against those who cause harm to Ryūshōgu. It has the ability to absorb energy through the cerata on its tail, and at other times, share that energy with others, and also has the role of purifying Ryūshōgu to its normal state.    Its Special Moves are raising only the water pressure in the enemy's surroundings and crushing them to death (Nirai Shikaishō), and firing a laser from its brow (Wadatsumi no Harae).

A Holy Dragon Digimon that resides in Ryūshōgu, an oceanic area in the eastern Digital World where beautiful crystals grow. Using the cloth wrapped around its body and its ability to manipulate seawater, it is able to create ocean current gates that can transport anyone anywhere, and it is impossible to reach the secluded region of Ryūshōgu without riding the ocean currents generated by Shagaramon.    Since it has the duty of banishing any Digimon that disturbs the peace in Ryūshōgu upon arriving there, Shagaramon has been entrusted as the gatekeeper of Ryūshōgu by Ryugumon. The Digimon responsible for gatekeeping alongside it include Hangyomon and Mermaimon, and Shagaramon has the additional role of supervising the other gatekeepers.    It also has the ability to fly in the air, and can occasionally be seen soaring gracefully through the skies above Ryūshōgu's waters.    Its Special Moves are creating a huge wave-like fan and hurling it at the opponent (Rōtō Sen), and detonating small spheres of compressed seawater (Kankai Sakusōjin). Finally, its "Sōten Ryūjinga" devours the opponent with a dragon made from seawater.

An Ice-Snow Digimon that rules over "Thrymheimr", a small, snow country somewhere in the snowy mountains. It appears to be a Digimon in the form of a giant snowman, but most of it resembles a powered suit made of ice. Skadimon's true form is the adorable fairy-like Digimon sitting inside the snow globe on its head.    Snow is always falling gently inside the globe, but when Skadimon fights or gets angry, its true form disappears from sight due to the blizzard. Thrymheimr is a small country where many Digimon that inhabit cold regions live, and is surrounded by ice shaped just like a snow globe. As with its head, the globe is a custom-made, solid ice wall created using Skadimon's abilities, and protects the inhabitants by blocking intruders.     When an enemy invades, it waves its stick to freely control snow and ice, and conjure various things to intercept them.     Its Special Moves are summoning a gigantic snow hand to beat down the enemy (Snow Swatter), and launching a large quantity of snowman-shaped missiles while skating with its ice skates (Snowman's Dance). When it reaches the peak of its anger, the globe on its head will break, and it unleashes its "Raging Avalanche", in which it engulfs the opponent in a avalanche that releases a huge amount of snow. Although the globe can easily regenerate, exposing its true form to danger is done as a last resort.

A Cyborg Digimon that is considered to be one of the elite within the aerial, covert honey base, "Royal Base". While Cannonbeemon protects the base over a vast range with its large body, Vespamon is in charge of defending key facilities, using its inexhaustible supply of stamina and speed as assets. Protecting the queen, Queenbeemon—the highest ranked at the base—above all else, Vespamon are known as the "Royal Guard" elite guards, and it is said that a handful of the strongest among them are awarded codenames and evolve into Tiger Vespamon. It fights placing an emphasis on cooperation with its comrades, and will not hesitate to sacrifice its life for the queen or the base.    Its Special Move is an attack using the "Royal Lance", a spear that is shrouded in a beam (Mach Stinger). In its "Bee Phalanx" tactical formation, it deploys a hexagonal beam shield from the "Royal Shield", and shoots energy from the spear at its ready.
ne: with or without certain Digimon from the Digimon Card Game
with or without certain Digimon from the Digimon Card Game

D.en: A Cyborg Digimon that belongs to the mysterious aerial, covert honey base, "Royal Base". While Waspmon is in charge of security for the base, Forgebeemon is responsible for the construction of the Royal Base. Its arm is equipped with an adhesive glue gun, and it uses the "Honey Glue" produced in its abdomen to bond materials together. On occasion, Funbeemon carrying materials also get stuck together, and in such situations, Forgebeemon uses its auxiliary arms to skillfully rescue them. A lot of its equipment can be used in battle, such as its other pair of arms that have turned into mecha arms and its saw-shaped stinger, and while they are a key factor for construction, they boast combat capabilities that cannot be taken lightly.    It is said that although Forgebeemon work hard day and night constructing things for their "Queen", they don't know what it is they are building.    Its Special Moves are tearing the opponent to pieces with the saw stinger on its rear (Torque Stinger), and an electrical discharge attack that uses the welding arms that extend from its back (Bumble Welder).
ne: with or without certain Digimon from the Digimon Card Game

D.en: A Digimon that evolved into the form of an ominous dragon that overwhelms those who see it by taking in data from heavy metal culture. It thinks of its battles as a show, has a belligerent personality in which it wanders around seeking "strong opponents" that are crucial for exciting its audience further, and will sometimes venture into the Dark Area, where evil beings thrive, in search of more exhilarating battles.    Its Black Digizoid-clad body makes the sound of metal rubbing against metal whenever it rushes about, and constantly emits some kind of "noise", such as making a roaring sound, from its guitar-shaped wings. Many Digimon find it troublesome coming into contact with Heavy Metaldramon, and because of the sounds it constantly produces, it is also easily spotted by enemies, so it very rarely encounters an opponent. Its desire to seek out strong opponents grows stronger the longer the time between battles. In battle, it specializes in various fighting styles contrary to its appearance; this includes a thunderous roar that can shatter the earth, power that utilizes its huge, heavy body, and attacks that capitalize on the shape changing of Black Digizoid.    Its Special Moves are pulverizing the enemy with a roaring sound emitted from its guitar-shaped wings (Black Sabbath), and spewing bluish-white hellfire from its mouth (Blue Murder Flame).
ne: with or without certain Digimon from the Digimon Card Game

D.en: Remodeled by the Crack Team to be pivotal in diversionary tactics, Invisimon is an Ultimate Digimon that is endowed with optical camouflage functions, and also possesses outstanding mobility due to its body being made of Blue Digizoid. Due to its excellent stealth abilities, even the cracker that it is under the employ of may lose track of its whereabouts, despite its large build. Unless one is extremely skilled, it will be difficult for them to handle Invisimon.    It rarely gets involved in intelligence operations, and its main role is basically to disrupt the scene by launching surprise attacks during missions or appearing suddenly and causing a rampage, and create an environment where other Crack Teams and Digimon can easily operate.    During battle, it fights by brandishing its partner, the "Stealth Wing", which is also endowed with optical camouflage functions. The Stealth Wing can be used as a long-distance navigation unit by being mounted to Invisimon's back, and is also capable of flying solo thanks to its autonomous AI, and by communicating with Invisimon, it can share what it sees from the sky.    Its Special Moves are throwing the Stealth Wing, and unleashing a slash attack that cannot be seen (Invisible Cutter), and delivering a blow that can penetrate even bedrock, fired from its wrist (Super Rocket Fist). Its "Ultimate Blazar" is an ultra-wide laser beam that wipes out enemies with the light emitted from its chest.

A God Man Digimon that contains the data of a Chinese moon goddess. It is a calm and beautiful Digimon that usually lives in solitude on its ship known as the Kōkankyū, which resembles the moon. Although it seldom has the chance to show it off, Jougamon is a master of Ch'uan Fa, and uses its specialty kicking techniques and high mobility to make sport of the opponent in battle. When faced with a powerful opponent, it summons its huge-bladed, crescent-shaped weapon called "Gyokuto", and fights boldly while wielding it freely. The way it fights with its Ch'uan Fa and Gyokuto is both feared and lauded as being chilling and beautiful, like the moonlight in winter.    Its Special Moves are jumping up while equipping Gyokuto to its foot, and then delivering a flying kick (Tsui Getsu Shō), and making Gyokuto spin rapidly to send out slashes into its surroundings (Gabi Seppa). Its "Taiin Kōkō", which emits light from a raised-up Gyokuto to heal its comrades, boasts of unrivaled healing power, but since it often spends its time alone, it has few opportunities to use it.

A Dragon Man Digimon with delicate scales and fins resembling a dress. It has the ability to synthesize various types of poison, such as those that paralyze the enemy, or those that melt substances. Making poisons that gradually shorten the opponent's life is Lamiamon's number one specialty, and it is said that this is because it takes pleasure in watching its opponents suffer. The umbrella it carries has the function of storing the poisons it synthesizes.    Due to it being well-versed in poisons, and the extent of its knowledge, it is capable of breaking down all kinds of viruses. Because of this, it seems that there are occasions when Lamiamon will detoxify other Digimon in exchange for a hefty reward.    Its Special Move is opening up its umbrella, coating it with poison, and attacking while scattering poison to contaminate its surroundings (Venobrella). It shoots a raging stream of concentrated poison from the tip of its umbrella (Splash Toxin) at opponents it deems unworthy of the amusement of watching suffer, killing them instantly.
ne: with or without certain Digimon from the Digimon Card Game

D.en: A Cyborg Digimon with control over flame, born from the data of a certain young god from Chinese legend. It possesses three treasure tools, and has the ability to wield them skillfully.    Despite its short appearance, it is an arrogant ruffian with a belligerent personality. Because of this, once Nezhamon starts acting violently, the only way to stop it is to get along with it in battle until it is satisfied. It fights while using the "Fukanirin" attached to its feet to soar through the air, brandishing the "Kasensō", which jets out flames, and freely wielding the "Kontenryō" wrapped around its neck.    At first glance, it is a troublemaker, but for better or worse, it also has a heroic nature and is sincere, so it has a somewhat likeable side as well.    Its Special Moves are a slash attack in which it fires a ring-shaped energy wave from the ring on its right wrist (Kenkonken), and using the Fukanirin to accelerate at full power, and then piercing the opponent with the Kasensō, accompanied by flames, while charging at high speed (Bakujin Engekiha).

Whenever a Digimon loses their memories or their behavior becomes erratic, those around it should beware of Oblivimon's presence. Covered in a flying saucer-like shell, this Cyborg Digimon vanishes as it silently draws near. After drawing nearer until it is directly above its target, it captures them by freely manipulating its tentacles, and takes them into its body.    The tips of its tentacles are equipped with multipurpose manipulators capable of hacking and performing attacks. The Digimon captured and taken in with its tentacles have their memories absorbed from within, and the data is stored in the biological storage on the upper part of its body. Digimon who have had information extracted from them are then expelled from the opening on the lower part of its body, but lose all of their memories.    Also, Oblivimon can send the hemispheric remote terminals equipped to its lower body into narrow spaces that it cannot penetrate. They are each capable of operating independently, and are excellent pieces of equipment responsible for reconnaissance, intelligence, and even assisting in attacks. When employed by the Crack Team, it is often in charge of leading intelligence operations teams with Espimon or Hover Espimon.    Its Special Moves are sending huge amounts of trash data into the enemies it seizes with its tentacles, causing an overflow in their thinking and rendering them incapacitated (Waste Abduction), and firing a laser beam from the opening on its lower body at the enemy from above (Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon).

D.en: An Ice-Snow Digimon that Digimon from snowy areas evolve into by taking in data related to winter sports. It has the ability to create tools made of ice, and typically makes skis and poles to freely slide around snow fields. It enters the dens of Mojyamon and Hyougamon as it skis about, and often causes trouble.    It also uses its ice axe to dig a den, and builds snow huts to secure shelter.    It frequently visits the small snow country of "Thrymheimr", and some individuals have been confirmed to take on the role of constructing homes for other Digimon.    Its Special Moves are turning its gun barrels toward the ground, using them like a jet pack to take off, and slashing the enemy with its skis while performing a spinning kick (Corkscrew Kick), and pouring on a barrage of snowballs from its bazooka with tremendous force (Winter Gunnery).

A Holy Beast Digimon that has been sighted in the various forest regions of the Digital World since ancient times. The huge horns on its head and the pipes growing from its abdomen have a structure similar to wind instruments, allowing it to play a variety of music.    It usually has a calm disposition, spending its time playing music along with the bird Digimon that perch on its huge horns, but on the other hand, Cernumon will severely punish invading enemies that try to enter and cause harm to the forest while letting out a loud warning sound in order to protect it.    The music played by Cernumon has the power to make plants grow instantly in any wasteland, transforming it into a fertile land. Also, whenever a fellow forest Digimon loses their life, it prays for their safe reincarnation into a Digitama through its music.    As such, it is a sacred Digimon that keeps regenerating the forest as it mourns countless deaths.    Its Special Moves are emitting a very loud, high-pitched sound from its horns and the pipes on its body which renders the opponent incapacitated (Celtic Bind), and mincing the opponent with the leaves that fall as it swings its tail (Scatter Gorm Glas).

A Reptile Digimon characterized by its large, frill-shaped sail. Its sail has the special characteristic of instantly healing wounds, even when damaged in battle. Since its sail grows larger each time it regenerates, individuals that have survived competition tend to have larger sails.    Although it looks sluggish, it can actually make its body appear bigger by expanding its frilly scales. Because it has very little actual mass and moves nimbly, it surprises invading enemies with the differences in its appearance.    Its Special Moves are spewing the energy that has been charged and amplified through its sail as a heat ray (Luminous Heat), and utilizing its agility to spin while jumping up, propping up its energized sail and charging forth, penetrating even rocks (Sailing Spin).

Dinomon is a pinnacle that Dinosaur Digimon finally reach after long battles.    An Ultimate Digimon that has awakened an ancient power, its tremendous energy appears as a glow on the surface of its body. Boasting astounding stamina and power, it tramples down the enemy with overwhelming force. As the battle heats up, the black scales that cover Dinomon turn red due to the heat, and it is able to use the energy within its body to attack more efficiently. It is said that when Dinomon fights in earnest, the entire area will be transformed into a wasteland with nothing but ash and lava.    Also, after battle, it has a habit of submerging into the sea in order to cool down its overheated body. Since a large amount of steam rises up as it cools off, the surrounding Digimon see this and realize that Dinomon has fought fiercely and become victorious.    However, its fighting spirit will never let it exhibit its immense power violently. The reason why Dinomon is feared is that it strategically corners the enemy with its composure, backed up by its high intelligence.    Its Special Move is reducing the enemy to ash with its flame-laden claws (Burning End). Its "Dino Breath" is an ultra-high temperature heat ray that completely melts everything, which it unleashes while emitting light from its dorsal plates and the surface of its body.

A Reptile Digimon characterized by its frill, which is soft like fabric. Its ears, which look like ribbons, are so good at picking up noises that they can react to even the slightest of sounds in their surroundings. It usually prefers inhabiting quiet areas, and folds its ears to shut out noise when sleeping. A species with an elegant personality, it is often regarded as cute, along with its frill and ears, but it also has a ferocious side where it spreads its frill wide and leaps at invading enemies.    Its Special Moves are mincing the opponent while rapidly spinning its frill (Frilled Cutter), and using the high-speed rotation of its frill to glide at low altitude, and landing a blow from its tail that makes use of its momentum (Helicop-Tail).

The awakened form Erlangmon puts on display after unleashing its power to the utmost limit only when eliminating enemies that it is incapable of defeating, even if they are observed with its third eye. It wears a transformed Kōtenken as armor, and the third eye above its head has the power to see through everything.    It fights while "observing" all things, including the opponent's thoughts as well, with its awakened third eye, and tears the enemy to pieces with the Sān Jiān Liǎng Rèn Dāo, which has turned into a gigantic energy form. It is safe to say that its fighting style, which can even foresee the future, is invincible. However, since Erlangmon's third eye is also its Digicore, it can be considered to be a dangerous form whose overwhelming strength comes at the expense of its Digicore being virtually exposed. Furthermore, the burden of managing its immense power and the information it observes is huge, so it cannot maintain this form for long.    Its Special Move is concentrating the energy surging from its third eye and shooting it clean through the enemy (Banshō Ikkan). In addition, it uses its unrivaled foresight to identify all of the enemy's behavioral patterns based on their physical and mental activity, and anticipate all of their attacks (Tengan Kensei).

A Mineral Digimon whose configuration data is made up mostly of sand. It claims the desert as its territory, moving around by blending into the sand in search of food. It bands together with herds of Sunarizamon to brace itself against invading enemies. It lets out a low-pitched, moan-like cry and gives instructions to the Sunarizamon via vibrations transmitted through the sand, and also has the nature of a leader of the pack.    As it fights by controlling the sand comprising its body, it despises moisture, and its strength is heavily influenced by the terrain. It exhibits unparalleled strength in the sand, and is feared as a hunter that manipulates quicksand to hunt its prey.    Its Special Moves are extending its retractable claws from beneath the ground and stabbing the opponent (Ground Spike), and producing a huge amount of quicksand and dragging the opponent underground (Desert Abyss).

A Digimon that evolved by taking in data from a variety of musical equipment and violent rock music, the armor covering its whole body is equipped with several features, such as speakers that amplify the sound taken in from the mic on its chest, and an effector that processes its voice. It deploys its main speakers during battle, and starts singing at a very loud volume.    Those who face it are unable to perform at their best due to being exposed to the roaring sound emitted from its entire body, while Loudmon itself becomes even more excited by the sound. To Loudmon, fighting is synonymous with acts known as live performances and gigs, and it is a unique Digimon with an unusual way of thinking where putting on an all-out performance is more important than winning or losing itself. After battle, it has a habit of praising the opponent for showing their full strength, and working together with them for a while.    Its Special Moves are tearing through the enemy with its claws, which have been sharpened by sound-induced vibrations (Metallica Edge), and shouting into the mic on its chest, focusing and then unleashing maximum volume shockwaves from the speakers on both its shoulders (Deep Purple Blaster).

A Mollusk Digimon whose whole body is covered in a mucus-like veil, it is often seen coexisting with Digimon such as Shellmon and Sangomon, who are also classified as Mollusk-types. Although it has an extremely strong sense of territoriality, and is merciless towards invading enemies that enter its territory, it also has a side with a strong sense of kinship, in which it tries to protect the Digimon it is in a symbiotic relationship with.    The mucus that covers its entire body is slimy, and reduces friction to the utmost limits. Since strikes and slashes are all hindered by its mucus, it boasts high defensive power despite its soft body surface. In exchange, its movements are very sluggish, so it camouflages itself by slipping into the sand beneath the sea, and making only the tentacles protruding from the device on its back be visible. It preys on enemies that enter its territory by dragging them into the sand with its tentacles that extend from the ocean floor, so if one spots Marin Bullmon's tentacles, they should be cautious of its surprise attacks.    Its Special Moves are shooting a high water pressure stream from its mouth (Hydro Demolisher), and spraying a viscous, poisonous liquid from the tubular organs concealed within its arms (Toxic Spread).

A Dragon Man Digimon that evolved via data from a mythological monster. During battle, the sentient serpent-dragons growing from its head drive the enemy away, so its true form rarely moves and often assumes an elegant stance. Even if someone is able to endure the serpent-dragons' attacks, it can deal with them easily in close combat with its fanged boots and the stinger on its tail.    It is extremely fond of small, round Digimon, and despite those it has taken an interest in likely being Babies, it will petrify them without mercy, take them home, and line them up as a collection.    Its Special Move is a kicking-blow that bites the enemy with the fangs on its boots (Biting Boot). Its "Eyes of Gorgon", in which it emits a flash from its large eye, petrifying anything the light touches, has the ability to rewrite the target's texture to stone, forcibly freezing them, and is a powerful technique that cannot be lifted unless Medusamon touches the opponent directly. In its "Raging Serpentine", where it unleashes its braided serpent-dragons, the serpent-dragons, who regain their original power by being unraveled, run rampant, so they exhibit high destructive power regardless of whether it is one-against-one or one-against-many.

A Mineral Digimon with a turtle-like appearance that primarily inhabits desert regions. It uses its drills and excavators to break through bedrock and move underground, but each time it does so, it triggers earthquakes, causing hollows in the ground and the ground to collapse. At night, it retracts its hind legs into its shell, and travels long distances by expelling the sand and gravel stored in its body in search of a safe place to sleep.    Most of its shell, which makes up more than half the volume of its body, is comprised of mineral data, so whenever a Proganomon gets erased, only its shell remains like a fossil. Sand-dwelling Digimon sometimes take up residence in the left-behind shell.    Its Special Moves are using its rapidly spinning claws to pulverize the opponent, along with their armor (Tricone Bit Demolisher), and firing the drills on its shell like missiles (Drill Emission).

A Digimon that evolved by taking in data on music and fashion from punk rock culture. Its personality is aggressive and rebellious, as if embodying the anarchic spirituality of punk rock. It is an anarchist at heart who rarely listens to what others say, and hates being ordered around or being part of a group.    It prefers flashy battles, and will do anything to liven up the atmosphere, such as getting attacked deliberately to show itself off. However, when there is no audience, it cannot get excited, and has a bad habit of losing its temper. During battle, it uses the guitar pick-shaped tip of its tail to strike against the ground or walls, creating a rhythm to hype itself up. The way it opens its mask wide to let out a distinctive roar is the epitome of a punk rocker.    Its Special Moves are sending out jets of flames from the brass knuckles on its hands and then pounding the opponent, branding them with the Digimoji for "PUNK" (Blitzkrieg Bop), and firing a blue flame shot from its mouth (Anarchist Flame).

A Digimon with an enormous figure that some Digimon evolve into by taking in data from ancient ruins scattered throughout the Digital World. Its body is comprised of sand data, and because it is constantly surrounded by a sandstorm, it keeps ordinary Digimon at bay.    As a result of absorbing ruins and the ancient data stored within them, it possesses extremely high intelligence and the power to hold its own, even when facing large armies. Since it consumes a lot of energy when active, it often sleeps camouflaging itself as a pyramid.    Even if it suffers heavy damage, it can instantly regenerate by taking in sand from its surroundings, so it is difficult to stop Pyramidimon in its tracks unless one attacks its Digicore directly.    Its Special Moves are spinning its pyramid-shaped fingers and pulverizing the opponent (Zofr Kabus), smashing the opponent from overhead with the pyramids on its shoulders (Apesh Eiqab), and unleashing a sandstorm from the eye on its chest which erodes everything (Laena Khamsin).

A Cyborg Digimon that is the ruler of the "Royal Base", serving as its "Queen", and also has an ambitious side that seeks the endless expansion of the base. Possessing high scientific and technological prowess, it designed and developed the Royal Base itself.    In addition, it boasts remarkable information processing abilities, such as handling defensive layouts and commanding formations during battle all by itself. On the other hand, its solo combat ability is inferior to Tiger Vespamon's, but it makes up for this with the multitude of functions of its covert honey weapon/throne, the "Royal Throne", which can be considered to be a part of its own body.    It has a conspicuous personality, and never fails to flaunt the fact that it is queen, even within the base. Queenbeemon's Digimon subordinates also revere it as their queen, and while it is being showered with calls of affection on the throne, it routinely waves its covert honey equipment, the "Beam Fan", around, which has absolutely no tactical effect at all.    Its Special Move is producing the most effective poison against its opponent and launching it at them from the Royal Throne's arm unit (Accel Stinger). In its "Hornet Eraser", a beam of light fired from the turret on the underside of the Royal Throne, the barrel is further expanded by being supplied with energy from the Royal Base, boosting its firepower to the point that it can blow a single mountain away.

A Ghost Digimon of the highest class that took in data from various ghosts and horrors on the Net. Its characteristic gravestone-like sword, the "Grave-Blade", is a brutal weapon that brings death to those who touch it, despite being blunt. If it encounters a superior Digimon as it wanders around, it will bring them down by stabbing them with the Grave-Blade without making a sound. As such, it takes pleasure in absorbing and consuming the fading data of the Digimon it defeats with the lantern it holds.    The data it absorbs with its lantern is recorded in the "Necronomicon", the book that it carries in its hand, and can be summoned as an apparition during battle.    While it possesses the powerful ability to manipulate the dead, it is considerably weak against light and holy power, so it never appears before Digimon that bear such power.    Its Special Moves are stabbing the Grave-Blade into the opponent as if it were an actual gravestone, penetrating their defenses, and completely destroying their Digicore (Soul Striker), and summoning the data of the Digimon it has absorbed as apparitions all at once, and annihilating the opponent with an army that will not stop regardless of how injured they are (Apparition Legion).

A form that the once-boisterous Nezhamon transformed into upon realizing that it should use its power properly. The "Fukanirin" have turned into a motorcycle with flaming tires, and the short body it used to have has grown larger as well. It has gained two pairs of adjustable Cyber Arms, becoming a Cyborg Digimon that uses six arms.    As with its form prior to transformation, it skillfully wields a variety of powerful treasure tools. It uses its six arms to freely wield its treasure tools that include the two swords, "Zanyōtō" and "Kanyōtō", the "Bakuyōsaku", which captures the target and restrains them, the "Kōyōsho", which knocks the opponent down, and the "Shūkyū", which chase the opponent to the ends of the earth and incinerate them, and fights to carry out justice with flawless tactics from any distance.    Nonetheless, as its belligerent nature remains the same, its only weakness is that it will often try to resolve things through fighting, even if its cause is just.    Its Special Moves are "Zankan Sōjingeki", in which it minces the enemy in the blink of an eye with its two swords, and "Hōshin Rokurenge", its ultimate secret technique where it unleashes its six treasure tools and channels all of its energy into a combo attack.
